title: Royal Indian Navy Mutiny
summary: On 18 February 1946 petty officers and ratings at HMIS Talwar, a signals establishment in Bombay, refused to work. The strike spread to shore bases and ships across South Asia, involving nearly 20,000 sailors in five days. Violence in Bombay and Karachi left many dead, and the action ended on 23 February 1946 with an amnesty-based settlement.

uncertainty.note: Start 18 February 1946 (both sources); end 23 February 1946 per EPW.

where.modern_name: Mumbai, India (proxy pin: city centre point; HMIS Talwar was in downtown Bombay)

importance.justification: Large-scale naval mutiny of nearly 20,000 sailors against British authority in India in 1946.
